**[[17 August 2019 Kabul bombing]]
***[[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] claims responsibility for a terrorist attack against a wedding party in Afghanistan the day prior, which left 63 people dead and over 200 injured. **[[Gibraltar]] authorities reject the request by the U.S. to seize the Iranian oil tanker ''[[Grace 1]]''. They argue that EU, not U.S. law, is applicable in Gibraltar. The tanker is also renamed. *[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]
**The organizers claim that at least 1.7 million people join a peaceful rally in [[Victoria Park (Hong Kong)|Victoria Park]], [[Hong Kong]]. Protesters spill into nearby streets, with train service intermittently suspended due to the sheer number of people.
